title: Google and Kaggle Launch Free AI Agents Vibe Coding Course — Registration Now Open | The Agent Report
highlights:
June 1, 2026 — Google and Kaggle have opened registration for the second edition of their free AI Agents Intensive course, running June 15–19, 2026. The updated curriculum introduces vibe coding — building AI agents using natural language as the primary programming interface — alongside new content on production deployment and a hands-on capstone project.
[...]
The first edition in November 2025 drew over 1.5 million learners, making it one of the most popular AI courses ever offered. This year’s version adds updated content, new speakers, and deeper coverage of agent quality, security, and deployment.
[...]
Each day includes whitepapers, companion podcasts, hands-on code labs, and a daily livestream on Kaggle’s YouTube channel with course authors and Google engineers. Participants also get access to dedicated channels on Kaggle’s Discord for discussion and Q&A.
[...]
The capstone project opens at the end of Day 5 (June 19) with a submission deadline of June 30. Participants must build a working AI agent and submit a Kaggle writeup, video explanation, design rationale, and code link. Top submissions receive Kaggle swag and recognition across Kaggle and Google social channels. All participants who complete the capstone earn a badge and certificate on their Kaggle profile.
[...]
## How to Register
[...]
Registration is free and open now at the Kaggle course overview page. Requirements:
[...]
- A Kaggle account (free, with phone verification)
- A Google AI Studio account (free)
- No programming experience necessary
[...]
All livestreams and recordings are available to registrants, and the course is developed directly by Google researchers and engineers.

title: June 17 - Build Vision Data Agents with Tools, Skills, and MCP - DEV Community
highlights:
June 17 - Build Vision Data Agents with Tools, Skills, and MCP - DEV Community

Join us on June 17 for a virtual workshop to learn how to build production-ready AI agents. Register for the Zoom!

Learn how to build production-ready AI agents that can reason over your data, automate complex tasks, and integrate seamlessly into your existing stack using tools, skills, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

We’ll walk through how modern agentic systems move beyond simple prompts—leveraging structured tools like dataset operations, embeddings, evaluation pipelines, and model execution to take real action. You’ll see how these agents can tag data, run inference, evaluate performance, and surface insights automatically, all within a unified workflow.

By combining natural language interfaces with programmable building blocks, teams can dramatically reduce manual effort, accelerate experimentation, and unlock faster decision-making across the ML lifecycle.

title: Operationalizing Agentic AI Tickets, Thursday, August 13  •  6 PM - 7 PM UTC | Eventbrite
highlights:
Operationalizing Agentic AI Tickets, Thursday, August 13 • 6 PM - 7 PM UTC | Eventbrite
[...]
# Operationalizing Agentic AI
[...]
ByData Science Connect
[...]
Thursday, August 13 • 2 PM - 3 PM EDT
[...]
Learn how to operationalize Agentic AI with governance, observability, and human control at scale.
[...]
Agentic AI is no longer theoretical. Systems that can reason, plan, and take action across workflows are entering production environments—and with them comes a new operational reality. The question is no longer can AI act autonomously, but how do we stay in control when it does?This webinar focuses on the practical mechanics of deploying agentic AI responsibly. We’ll examine how to design governance frameworks that go beyond static guardrails, implement observability that surfaces intent and intermediate reasoning, and maintain meaningful human-in-the-loop oversight without slowing down innovation. From dynamic policy enforcement to real-time monitoring and escalation paths, we’ll explore how enterprises can operationalize autonomy without sacrificing accountability.If your organization is experimenting with AI agents—or preparing to move from pilots to production—this session will help you build systems that are not only capable, but controllable.
[...]
What You'll Learn:
[...]
1️⃣ Governance for Autonomous Systems: How to design policy layers, permissioning models, and approval workflows that align agent behavior with organizational risk tolerance and regulatory requirements.2️⃣ Observability Beyond Outputs: Why logging final responses isn’t enough—and how to instrument reasoning traces, tool usage, and memory state to create transparency in agent decision-making.
[...]
3️⃣ Human-in-the-Loop by Design: Practical patterns for escalation, intervention, and override that preserve human authority while enabling agents to operate efficiently across complex workflows.4️⃣ From Pilot to Production Control: The architectural considerations—modular workflows, sandboxing, audit trails, and feedback loops—that make agentic systems safe and sustainable at enterprise scale.
[...]
